tips: Elise has a quick 3 camp clear and looks to gank, much faster than Nunu. You should aim to counter gank where you think she will go or gank the opposite side of the map.
Red Kayn is a nightmare. He outdamages, outsustains and is more mobile than Nunu. Not to mention he can knock you out of your R.
Outdamages and outsustains Nunu, he is difficult to run away from and you should never look to fight without help.
Clears faster than Nunu and his wards can stop your snowball (W). Has a fear that cancels your ult and outdamages you with his Ult.
Generally looks to invade and kill you early. Her ult counters yours and she can also use it on Dragon to counter your Q+Smite. Never 1v1.
Never try to 1v1, run away as she will look to engage. You need a team to back you up.
He can Q your snowball if he times it correctly. You can't 1v1 him and he outscales you. Try to save W to CC him for your team to kill.
Very broken champion right now (11.13), he generally looks to lvl 2 gank. Difficult to run away from without flash and will always win 1v1. Pray your laners ward. (I currently ban him or Lee).
Will always win 1v1, only a threat if he is fed. His resets are very annoying because he can dodge your ult and W.
Kills you if he lands Q. Outdamages you, stays on you even with phase rush. Respect him and give objectives unless you have a team to back you up. (Perma ban him until he is nerfed)
Presses R and now you lose objectives if he is smart with timing. Never fight him in his R unless very behind, try your best to survive.
If she has a brain she makes you useless once she hits lvl 3. She has a wall which blocks your snowball (W) and a stun which can cancel your ultimate. Not to mention her damage is BONKERS.
Outscales you and farms much faster. In the early game you can all in him and kill him 1v1 if he misses abilities, don't be afraid of him if you have double buffs.
Major threat post level 6. Don't fight without team, try to use oracles lens and peel your carries. She can't match your ganks early though.
Faster than you and can lock you down, never 1v1. His stun (E) is a very short cooldown and will cancel your ultimate.
Only becomes a threat if she snowballs early game. Pray you dodge her spears. If she is behind you can usually 1v1 her.
She can snare you while snowballing easily, and her black shield counters your knock up. Will generally ult you and then zhonyas. Less frequent in jungle but still clears faster than Nunu.
She will generally hold her E to stop your snowball or ultimate. Mainly just annoying. Not ban worthy and you can generally 1v1 if she uses E early.
Steals your stats with his ultimate and his pillar will stop your snowball.
Very mobile and difficult to lockdown. Her ultimate generally gets you killed or will cancel your ultimate. She also outclears you and likes to steal camps.
If skilled he can kite you, dodge your W and generally kill you. He scales incredibly well and is always stealing camps.
Never fight him isolated as he gains extra damage. If he is fed he WILL one shot you, stay with your team and give scuttles if you dont have help.
If he gets fed you will have a hard time dealing with him. You can generally escape him with blue smite and phase rush.
Can be annoying if he holds his stun to cancel your ult or snowball. Respect his damage early.
Only really a threat if fed. Post 6 she can lock you down with R. She outdamages you.

Will generally invade the opposite buff you start at. He scales incredibly well with items. You can Q+smite daisy early though to remove her from fights. Look to invade his camps early if you are ahead or have vision on him.
Her parry will cancel your snowball knockup and stun you. She can quickly kill you 1v2 with a slight lead. Don't look to fight unless you have backup or vision on enemy jungler.
His trap is very annoying as it cancels your W. Late game if you get trapped its 50/50 if you get killed.
He can cancel your snowball with his knockup and quickly kill you if he is fed. Be careful.
Avoid ganking unless you know her sleep is on cooldown. She can 1 combo kill you as early as level 3 with ignite. If she misses, you kill her.
Most like to level 2 gank. He can cancel your ult with E+Q, but you can also cancel his engage with your W.
Can cancel your snowball and kill you in a few auto attacks if fed.
She is annoying as she has 2 abilities that will cancel your snowball or ultimate.
If he double dashes away from your snowball he can turn on you and kill your quite easily.
If she is fed she will melt you. Be careful for her condemn and she can turn ganks in her favor if you become stunned.
His stun will cancel your W as well as R. Respect his damage if ahead.
Difficult to gank if his knock up is up. If he misses you kill.
If he lands his stun you might die. He also makes people fast so can easily turn fights into the enemies favor as well as giving them 2nd life.
Respect her damage at all stages of the game. She can easily lock you down and kill you 1v1 with a slight lead.
Traps can be annoying with proper placement as you are snowballing.
Sometimes hard to lock down with her speed boost. She can also turn fights in enemy favor if you miss W as she will root you.
Her traps can sometimes turn fights in enemy favor. If she is behind you can easily 1v1 her once level 6.
He is weak pre level 6. If you don't impact the game early he will quickly outscale you. Respect his damage late game.
Her ult can be annoying and lock you down. Respect her if she is fed.
Doesn't do much to Nunu. Be aware in objective fights as he may flash+R you to kill you with his team.
Only a threat if he becomes fed and steals your ult (the damage is bonkers). Try to cancel him using your ult with your snowball.
Don't be afraid of him early and try to put him behind as he will be useless. If he is fed respect him because he can one combo you with his W.
Your ganks are better than his, he generally can't kill you 1v1 unless fed. Try to not let him mark you in long fights as he can sustain off of you.
Scary lion if ahead, scaredy cat if behind. Try to avoid bushes without vision, you stomp him if ahead.
Really annoying if he becomes fed with mejais. Save Q+Smite for objectives as he can easily steal if you aren't paying attention.
Bonks you if he is ahead and can chase you down, also cancels your ult and W with his ult. Kinda coinflip.
Sometimes looks to invade you level 2-3, be aware of this if he is running ignite. His boxes stop your W, but you can also sustain off of them with Q.
Not a threat until level 6+. Try to impact the game early so your team can kill him.
Will sometimes look to invade you once he hits 6, pay attention to your laners pings. He can be annoying to gank as well, don't chase him without vision.
Is quite annoying to gank with her shroud and dash. He can generally 1v2 post 6 if she has a lead. Respect her.
Very annoying to gank, don't focus her post level 3 unless she doesn't have her rappel ability. She can still cast it even after being knocked up.
Don't go near her if she is fed unless you have a team to back you up. She can ignore your ult damage and basically one shot you late game.
Her pool is annoying as it will cancel your W, she can also chase you down if she lands abilities. Only a threat if fed.
Annoying to gank as she can easily juke your snowball. If she is fed just ignore her unless team is near. Save your W to cancel her ult.
Super easy to abuse early and spam gank. Careful the later the game goes as she scales very well.
Polymorph is very annoying and ruins your ganks. Respect her damage and ultimate as it can turn fights.
